bio: Located in the heart of the city, this restaurant forms part of a wider complex that offers something for everyone, including bars, apartments, a terrace and a cinema. A brewery is at the core of it all however, with exclusive beers available in the restaurant alongside local radlers perfect for a hot summer’s day. The cooking is hearty and doesn’t skimp on flavour, in nourishing dishes such as gnocchi with roasted pumpkin or a tweaked version of tiramisu.
